description: This is a Java source file defining the ServiceValidationException class, which extends GenericServiceException. It provides mechanisms to represent validation errors related to services, including details about missing and extra fields, messages, and associated service information.

classes.name: ServiceValidationException
classes.description: Exception class for service validation errors, containing details about invalid, missing, or extra fields in a service request, as well as associated service context.

methods.name: getExtraFields
methods.description: Returns a list of extra fields identified during validation.

methods.name: getMissingFields
methods.description: Returns a list of missing fields identified during validation.

methods.name: getMessageList
methods.description: Returns a list of validation messages; null if none.

methods.name: getModelService
methods.description: Returns the ModelService associated with this exception.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the associated service, or null if none.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns a detailed message string, including validation messages.
